assumptions.name: envelope signing
assumptions.value: Ed25519, one signing time at server start, validity window 24 h

assumptions.name: protocol IDs
assumptions.value: one protocol ID per DNS protocol key (ADR 0006), all of the same length

assumptions.name: firmware payload
assumptions.value: schema.Firmware version 2.4.1, the same bytes in every baseline

assumptions.name: https server
assumptions.value: one self-signed Ed25519 certificate, TLS 1.3 only

assumptions.name: coap server
assumptions.value: go-coap v3.8.2 UDP server defaults, confirmable GET only

assumptions.name: dns server
assumptions.value: pkg/server defaults, one UDP and TCP port for the three DNS baselines

assumptions.name: lookup deadline
assumptions.value: 5 s per lookup; a lookup that misses it is a failure

assumptions.name: latency
assumptions.value: wall-clock time from the start of the lookup to the verified envelope, socket creation included

assumptions.name: percentiles
assumptions.value: nearest-rank p50 and p95 of the successful lookups

assumptions.name: coap request count
assumptions.value: a loopback relay in the client counts the CoAP transmissions; it adds one loopback hop in each direction

assumptions.name: coap retransmission check
assumptions.value: every 10 ms; the go-coap default is every 4 s

assumptions.name: packets and bytes
assumptions.value: eth0 rx plus tx of the client container over the whole run, divided by n

assumptions.name: client footprint
assumptions.value: each client does 100 lookups against baseline servers on the loopback of the host, with no netem

assumptions.name: loss shaping
assumptions.value: tc netem delay 10ms loss X% on eth0 of both containers, so each direction gets X%
